targets.old_statement: For a driver younger than 21, a single conviction carrying at least 4 points can cause suspension; for someone younger than 18, at least 4 points in 12 months can do so.
targets.old_spoken_statement: For a driver younger than twenty-one, a single conviction carrying at least four points can cause suspension; for someone younger than eighteen, at least four points in twelve months can do so.
targets.statement: Georgia suspends the license of any driver younger than twenty-one convicted of a four-point violation, and of any driver younger than eighteen who accumulates four points within twelve months.
